description_en: Calls ModifyInstanceType to change the specifications of an instance
name: ModifyInstanceType

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The new node specifications of the master node. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html to obtain the available node specifications.

You must specify either the MasterInstanceType parameter or the CoreInstanceType parameter
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的Master节点规格。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html接口获取。

MasterInstanceType参数和CoreInstanceType参数需要填写其中一个
parameters.name: master_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The new node specifications of the core node. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html to obtain the available node specifications.

You must specify either the MasterInstanceType parameter or the CoreInstanceType parameter
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的Core节点规格。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145796.html接口获取。

MasterInstanceType参数和CoreInstanceType参数需要填写其中一个
parameters.name: core_instance_type
